```{r load packages, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library("thief")
library("MAPA")
library("hts")
library("fable")

library(forecast)

library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoltr)
library(covidHubUtils)

```


```{r, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
full_hosp_truth <- load_truth("HealthData", 
                         "inc hosp", 
                         temporal_resolution="weekly",
                         data_location = "remote_hub_repo")


start_date <- as.Date("2020-07-27") # a monday
end_date <- as.Date("2021-07-26")

hosp_truth <- full_hosp_truth %>%
  dplyr::filter(target_end_date >= start_date,
                target_end_date <= end_date,
                location == "US") %>%
  mutate(day = wday(target_end_date), epi_week = epiweek(target_end_date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(value, epi_week, day)

ht_day <- hosp_truth$value
ht_day_ts <- ts(ht_day, start = c(2020, 179), end = c(2021, 178), frequency = 365)

# create list of aggregation levels
agg_list <- list(56, 42, 28, 14, 7, 1)

# Construct aggregates
ht_day_ts_ <- ts(ht_day, start = c(4,1), end = c(10, 29), frequency = 56) 

day_agg_ <- tsaggregates(ht_day_ts_, m = 56, aggregatelist = agg_list)
agg.names <- c("daily", "weekly", "2-weekly", "4-weekly", "8-weekly")
for(i in seq_along(day_agg_))
   names(day_agg_)[[i]] <- agg.names[i]
```   

``` {r extended truth data}
# an extra 1*(top agg level) of truth data to plot against forecasts
extended_truth <- full_hosp_truth %>%
  dplyr::filter(target_end_date >= end_date,
                target_end_date <= end_date + weeks(8),
                location == "US") %>%
  mutate(day = wday(target_end_date), epi_week = epiweek(target_end_date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(value, epi_week, day)

long_truth <- rbind(hosp_truth, extended_truth)

long_ts <- ts(long_truth$value, start = c(4,1), end = c(11, 29), frequency = 56) 

long_aggs <- tsaggregates(long_ts, m = 56, aggregatelist = agg_list)
for(i in seq_along(long_aggs))
   names(long_aggs)[[i]] <- agg.names[i]

for(i in seq_along(day_agg_))
   names(day_agg_)[[i]] <- agg.names[i]

periods <- as.double(diff.Date(c(start_date, end_date)))/56

dates_actual_agg <- rep(start_date - weeks(1), floor(periods))
for (i in 1:length(dates_actual_agg)) {
  dates_actual_agg[i] <- start_date + (i-1)*weeks(8)
}
plot(day_agg_, main="Covid-19 Inc Hosp", xaxt = "n")
axis(1, at=4:9, labels = dates_actual_agg, line = 1.1)
```
```{r base forecasts}
# vector of actual dates
dates_actual_forecast <- rep(start_date - weeks(1), floor(periods) + 1)
for (i in 1:length(dates_actual_forecast)) {
  dates_actual_forecast[i] <- start_date + (i-1)*weeks(8)
}

# Compute base forecasts
 base_fc_day <- list(); fits <- list()
 for(i in seq_along(day_agg_)){
   base_fc_day[[i]] <- forecast(auto.arima(day_agg_[[i]]), h=frequency(day_agg_[[i]]), level = c(10, 50, 80, 95))
   fits[[i]] <- auto.arima(day_agg_[[i]]) 
   # SARIMA(0,1,0)(1,0,0)[56]; ARIMA(1,1,0); AR(2) w/ non-zero mean; AR(1)
   # of course these change depending on the data
 }
```

```{r obtain median point forecast}
forecasts <- USAccDeaths %>% # A time series object with month and year
  as_tsibble() %>%
  model(arima = ARIMA(log(value) ~ pdq(0, 1, 1) + PDQ(0, 1, 1))) %>% # model SARIMA(0,1,1)(0,1,1)
  forecast(bootstrap = TRUE) %>% # Produces simulated trajectories for each
  mutate(
    median = purrr::map_dbl(
      value, # Bootstrap sample of potential forecasts
      function(fc_value) {
        median(fc_value$transform(fc_value$dist$x)) 
        # Extract the median of the results, possibly after dealing with any transformations
        # Transformation: exp(value); Backtransformation: log(value)
      })
  )
 

# THIS WORKS!!
new <- full_hosp_truth %>%
  dplyr::filter(target_end_date >= start_date,
                target_end_date <= end_date,
                location == "US") %>%
  select(target_end_date, value) %>%
  as_tsibble() %>%
  model(arima = ARIMA(log(value) ~ pdq() + PDQ())) %>% # It seems that we have to log value
  forecast(bootstrap = TRUE, h = frequency(day_agg_[[1]])) %>%
  mutate(
    median = purrr::map_dbl(
      value,
      function(fc_value) {
        median(fc_value$transform(fc_value$dist$x))
      })
  )


tester <- day_agg_[[1]] %>%
  as_tsibble() %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(index)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(rank, value) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = rank) %>%
  model(arima = ARIMA((value) ~ pdq() + PDQ())) %>% # It seems that we have to log value
  forecast(bootstrap = TRUE, h = frequency(day_agg_[[1]]), point_forecast = list(.median = median)) %>%
  mutate(
    median = purrr::map_dbl(
      value,
      function(fc_value) {
        median(fc_value$transform(fc_value$dist$x))
      })
  )

tester_pi <- tester %>%hilo(level=c(80, 95))
tester_pi_80_lower <- tester_pi$`80%`$lower

tester2 <- day_agg_[[1]] %>%
  as_tsibble() %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(index)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(rank, value) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = rank) %>%
  model(arima = ARIMA(log(value) ~ pdq() + PDQ())) %>% 
  forecast(level = c(80, 95), 
  h = frequency(day_agg_[[1]])) 

# Using base forecasts
base_fc_day[[1]]
t1 <- forecast(auto.arima((day_agg_[[1]])), 
                 h=frequency(day_agg_[[1]]), 
                 level = c(80, 95)) # This obtains the forecasts by using a bootstrapping method
t2 <- forecast(auto.arima((day_agg_[[1]])), 
                 h=frequency(day_agg_[[1]]), 
                 level = c(0, 80, 95),
                 bootstrap = TRUE, npaths = 5000)
t3 <- fabletools::forecast(auto.arima((day_agg_[[1]])), 
                 h=frequency(day_agg_[[1]]))
auto_forecast <- auto.arima(day_agg_[[1]])
arima(day_agg_[[1]])

arima.sim(auto_forecast, n = 100)

model_fable <- day_agg_[[1]] %>%
  as_tsibble() %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(index)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(rank, value) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = rank) %>%
  model(arima = ARIMA(value ~ pdq() + PDQ()))

temp <- day_agg_[[1]] %>%
  as_tsibble() %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(index)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%

ARIMA(temp$value ~pdq() + PDQ())

temp %>%
```

``` {r reconciled forecasts}
# Reconcile forecasts
reconciled_fc_day <- reconcilethief(base_fc_day, aggregatelist = agg_list)

# Plot forecasts before and after reconciliation
par(mfrow=c(3,2), mai=c(0.35,0.5,0.35,0.35))
for(i in seq_along(base_fc_day))
{
  plot(reconciled_fc_day[[i]], main=agg.names[i], shadecols = c("light gray", "#C2DDEE", "#00458F") , 
       xaxt = "n", #axes = FALSE,
       ylim = c(0, max(reconciled_fc_day[[i]]$x, reconciled_fc_day[[i]]$upper))) 
  lines(reconciled_fc_day[[i]]$mean, col=4, lwd=2) # plots blue reconciled forecasts line
  lines(base_fc_day[[i]]$mean, col='red') # plots red mean line
  lines(long_aggs[[i]], col='black', lwd=1.5, lty = "dotted")
  axis(1, at=4:10, labels = dates_actual_forecast)
  axis(2)
}
points(base_fc_day[[5]]$mean, col= 'red')
```
